curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When bitter community opposition collides at a shared negotiating table, neither leader expects the summit to reshape their world.
curatedMovie.description: In 1971 North Carolina, civil rights activist Ann Atwater and Ku Klux Klan leader C.P. Ellis are reluctantly pushed together to co-chair a tense community summit over school desegregation in Durham.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, thoughtful historical drama with steady pacing and emotionally charged stakes suited for engaged solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Robin Bissell directs a deliberate historical drama anchored in real-world friction, exploring what happens when fierce ideological adversaries share a room.
